# The Tech Docket
> Daily signal on tech & AI — what the world is searching, and why

The Tech Docket is a daily, data-picked publication covering technology and artificial intelligence across India and globally. Every article is built on same-day search-demand data, thoroughly researched from verified primary sources, and published with machine-checked factual accuracy gates and zero affiliate links.

## Core Feeds
- [Sitemap](https://thetechdocket.com/sitemap.xml): Full XML sitemap of all published articles and pages
- [RSS Feed](https://thetechdocket.com/feed.xml): Rolling RSS 2.0 feed of latest 20 articles with WebSub hub
- [Today's Docket](https://thetechdocket.com/docket/): 60-second daily briefing of verified tech developments
- [The Deck](https://thetechdocket.com/deck/): Browse-and-save archive of every daily card

## Topic Hubs
- [AI Models](https://thetechdocket.com/topics/ai-models/): New and updated AI models, and what actually changed between one release and the last. We report benchmarks with the caveats attached, and lead with the question most readers arrive with: does this change anything about the way you already work?
- [AI Tools & Apps](https://thetechdocket.com/topics/ai-tools/): The AI apps and tools people are actively searching for, weighed against what they claim to do. Pricing, real usage limits, and the gap between a launch demo and a week of daily use.
- [Big Tech](https://thetechdocket.com/topics/big-tech/): What Google, Microsoft, Apple, Meta, OpenAI, Amazon and Nvidia ship, buy and quietly retire — and how those decisions reach the people who will never watch a keynote.
- [Chips & Hardware](https://thetechdocket.com/topics/hardware/): Chips, GPUs, memory and the physical machinery underneath the AI boom. Supply, pricing and manufacturing reality, plus what a spec sheet does and does not tell you about the device in your hand.
- [Policy & Society](https://thetechdocket.com/topics/policy/): Rules, courts, regulators and the social consequences of technology, with a standing eye on how decisions made in Brussels, Washington or Beijing land on Indian users, workers and companies.
- [How-To & Explainers](https://thetechdocket.com/topics/explainers/): Plain-language answers to the questions people search for most: how a thing works, whether you actually need it, and what to do next. No assumed background.
